base: Use case: web-app-mockup. Design a complete high-fidelity DESKTOP office operations web app for AzərTur. This is the office staff workspace, not customer marketing pages, not driver/guide apps. Reference image1 is approved customer cabinet and image2 approved planner: use their restrained visual language, warm off-white #faf8f4, charcoal, forest green, pale sage, flat muted orange, Manrope-like typography, subtle 3px corners, thin dividers. No neon, gradients, glassmorphism, pill badges, eyebrow labels, decorative stats cards, graphs, generic AI chatbot, gamification, huge hero photos, device frames or browser chrome. Data-focused and calm, comfortable readable office density. Entire screen from top navigation to bottom action area must be visible. Wide desktop artboard, approximately 1600px width, tall as necessary for full content. A white 200px left sidebar across the full page: orange A / azərtur logo, small plain "Operations"; navigation Overview, Requests (active orange underline), Customer requests, Tours, Quotes, Notifications; bottom "Office staff" and Sign out. Top thin white header breadcrumb "Requests / 42bf2845", right EN / EUR / Operator. Use a real working layout with table rows, fields and sidebar summary, not generic stacked tile cards. Simple outline icons. All data illustrative. Full request sample: Alex Morgan, alex@example.com, 15–16 May 2027, Quba → Khinalug, 2 travelers, 2 days / 1 night. No real supplier identities or inventory guarantees. Group estimate EUR495: driver2days×90=180, Comfort1room×1night×110=110, English guide2days×65=130, airporttransfer1×35=35, craft2people×20=40. Paid0. Do not add catalog package price, VAT, discounts, markup or fees. Cancellation policies are per service/provider/time, not a universal 48/72h rule or refund percentage. No fixed deposit percent. No payment gets triggered by preparing/sending an offer. Offer/contract workflow is a PROPOSED future capability; don't label it live.

Primary request: COMPLETE Request review page, clearly an operational review workspace. Main heading "Custom journey" and simple plain status clock "Needs review"; request reference #42bf2845 beneath. Header actions small outlined "Back to requests", orange "Prepare offer →", no Approve and pay shortcut. Horizontal compact facts strip with Customer / Alex Morgan / alex@example.com; Travel dates /15–16 May 2027; Travelers /2; Request language /English. Underlined tabs "Request details" active, "Offer", "Activity". Two-column content: wide left 70%, right 30% with sticky-looking summary. Left section "Requested itinerary": editable-looking Day1 Quba, Day2 Khinalug in two restrained rows, label "Return route to be confirmed with the team." Small outline route line, no invented map or times. "Customer notes" plain text box "A relaxed pace, with time for village walks." Below distinct small section "Internal office note" multiline text field placeholder "Supplier calls, availability notes…", explicit caption "Visible to office staff only." Right panel "Review summary": "Estimated total €495", "Paid €0"; thin divider "Availability checked 2 of 5", "Service terms reviewed 2 of 5". Checklist text "Confirm selected suppliers", "Complete service cancellation terms", "Review the final customer offer"; not all checked. Right lower note "Before you send" / "Each selected service needs confirmed availability and customer-facing terms." Bottom full-width action area inside content "Changes are not saved yet." outlined "Save notes", orange "Prepare offer →". Small muted footer "Design proposal · sample data". Main page ~1600×1450, full workspace visible with generous readable body text.

Primary request: one complete wide office app view with an OPEN centered large service editor dialog over a dimmed offer-composer workspace. Show enough actual workspace around dialog to understand context. No mobile view required. Dialog is a usable detailed form, not tiny floating card: title "Edit service", subheading "Comfort stay · 15–16 May 2027 · 2 guests". Top right close X. Two-column form, stacked clear sections. "Service details": Service name input "Comfort stay"; Source dropdown "Manual"; Supplier/property input empty with placeholder "Choose or enter supplier"; Location "Quba"; Availability dropdown currently "Not checked" with choices Not checked, Confirmed, Unavailable (closed dropdown, avoid giant menu). Note "Changing status records an office check; it does not book the supplier." "Customer price": Rooms stepper1; Nights stepper1; Unit price field EUR110; computed right-aligned "Service total €110". No supplier cost or profit margin fields. "Customer-facing cancellation terms" textarea EMPTY with placeholder "Enter supplier policy, time cutoffs and refund conditions."; small guidance "Required before sending the offer. Policy depends on this service and supplier." No fabricated financial rules. "Internal supplier note" separate textarea placeholder "Call details or supplier reference"; small lock icon caption "Only office staff can see this note." A pale sage summary band at bottom of form "1 room × 1 night × €110" / "€110"; caption "Only this service changes. Other selected services are preserved." Footer clear secondary "Cancel" and flat orange "Save service →". No Send offer inside this modal. Show complete dialog with padding and all fields readable at1600×1250-ish. Background only incidental and dimmed; canonical main composer must be used in code. Small bottom caption outside UI "Design proposal · sample data".
